args.question: What is the cardholder statement about this transaction?

args.narrative: The cardholder says they did not make this purchase. The 74.58 USD transaction on 2026-01-24 was approved with AVS match (Y) and CVV match (M), and the device and IP used match the cardholder on file. The order was delivered by USPS on 2026-02-03. Receipt and authorization record attached.

args.explanation: Visa 10.5 fraud, 74.58 USD. Represented with AVS Y / CVV M, matching device/IP, authorization, receipt and USPS delivery proof. The case moved directly to pre-arbitration awaiting the issuer, with no merchant actions allowed when I checked. On 2026-02-24 a deadline_missed event resolved the case; the ledger shows the cardholder kept the funds and the merchant paid 15.00 processor plus 25.00 network fees, so I count this as lost. I am not certain whose deadline was missed; I may have needed to act during that window and did not.
